meta.title: Buyer revokes a pending counter offer
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ in evaluation rather than creating or searching for another event.
Enable counter offers on RFQs for the case.
Keep event withdrawal actions available as required by the setup.
Enable eRFX projects for the prepared RFQ event.
Open the RFQ Responses tab containing Vendor A's normal bid.
Confirm the response is associated with Vendor A.
Confirm Vendor A's original bid is present before the counter offer.
Send the pending counter offer against Vendor A's own bid.
Verify the buyer-side grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as initiated.
Revoke the pending counter offer from Vendor A's bid.
Verify the buyer can offer a counter again after revocation.
Verify the pending-counter revoke action is no longer shown.
Open the comparison grid to verify the original bid value is active again.
Confirm Vendor A's active bid has returned to the original price of 100.
Inspect Vendor A's supplier-portal view after revocation.
Open the RFQ pricing round where a pending counter offer would be shown.
Verify Vendor A no longer sees a pending counter offer.
Verify Vendor A can revise and resubmit the bid after the counter offer is revoked.
Confirm the vendor revision was accepted and submitted.
